_doc: Everything particular to THIS agent lives here, in people.json, prompt.md and state/. The code in this folder carries no household or business specifics, so a new agent is a copy of the folder with these files rewritten.
name: Sage
household: owner1 and owner6 example (home in example; business example-org, wedding videography in example)

burst._doc: A Google Chat line waits until its sender has been quiet settle_s seconds, so a burst of lines gets ONE answer; a slow typist's lines wait pace_factor x their largest gap; no group waits past max_wait_s. Local channel and slash commands never wait.
